subject.title: refactor(auth): finish SQLite-only auth profile cutover

question: Should the deprecated `AuthStorage.create(path)` and `FileAuthStorageBackend` APIs be allowed to redirect arbitrary legacy file paths to a derived per-agent SQLite owner during the deprecation window, or must nonstandard path users retain a defined compatibility or migration path?
rationale: This is a published Plugin SDK behavior contract, not only an internal refactor: the SQLite-only architecture is supported by repository policy, but the acceptable upgrade behavior for existing external plugins requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the documented redirect
options.body: Accept the SQLite-only redirect as the deprecation contract and make the nonstandard-path upgrade effect explicit in SDK documentation and release context.

options.title: Preserve a defined migration boundary
options.body: Keep the SQLite-only runtime while adding a narrow, documented compatibility or migration path for nonstandard legacy storage locations during the announced window.

options.title: Narrow the supported deprecated API
options.body: Reject arbitrary-path compatibility and require an explicit maintainer-approved breaking-change boundary before published plugins must move to `forAgent(agentDir)`.

recommendation.title: Preserve a defined migration boundary
recommendation.body: Keep the SQLite-only runtime while adding a narrow, documented compatibility or migration path for nonstandard legacy storage locations during the announced window.

likelyOwner.reason: The current auth-storage cutover series and SDK transition are concentrated in this contributor's branch history.
